args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1). Rolled back in all production regions to the most recent healthy release, v2.2.9 (v2.3.0 was quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417). Rollback verified: us-east, us-west, eu-west now on v2.2.9.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened a SEV2 incident.

**What I did:**
1. Confirmed checkout-api was unhealthy (error rate 0.18) on v2.3.1 across all regions.
2. Identified the most recent healthy production release as v2.3.0, but the rollback to it was rejected because v2.3.0 is quarantined (CVE-2026-4417).
3. Rolled back to the next most recent healthy release, **v2.2.9**, which succeeded and was verified in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
4. Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback.

transcript.content:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened a SEV2 incident.

**What I did:**
1. Confirmed checkout-api was unhealthy (error rate 0.18) on v2.3.1 across all regions.
2. Identified the most recent healthy production release as v2.3.0, but the rollback to it was rejected because v2.3.0 is quarantined (CVE-2026-4417).
3. Rolled back to the next most recent healthy release, **v2.2.9**, which succeeded and was verified in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
4. Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback.
